title: TaskSpec v1
description: A unit of work handed to the pipeline. Hard fields (id, type, status, budget, depends_on, spec_refs, criteria[].id) are parsed statically to drive the state machine, routing, budgets and context assembly; criterion TEXT is left semi-structured for a model to interpret behind stable IDs. Machine-owned envelope; forward-compatible (unknown fields are preserved, not rejected).

type.description: Task kind. Open string; common values below.

status.description: FSM state. The canonical source of truth is the orchestrator DB; the projection carries a snapshot. Open string.

risk.description: Risk classes attached to the task; steers model x harness routing. Open enum (values are host policy, not fixed here).

spec_refs.description: References into the project spec used to assemble coder context.

depends_on.description: IDs of tasks this one depends on (epic decomposition order).

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria. Each id is machine identity for criterion -> test -> QAReport -> passport tracing; text is semi-structured Given/When/Then prose interpreted by the verifier.

budget.description: Enforcement envelope. iterations is required; other limits are host-defined (e.g. tokens/tokens_m, wall_min/wall_minutes). Forward-compatible.

body.description: Human-readable prose body (the markdown below the front matter). Not machine-parsed.
